title: Edit the plate
prompt: Make a rectangular plate 100 mm long along X, 60 mm wide along Y and 8 mm thick, lying on the Top plane centred on the origin, from z = 0 up to z = 8 mm. Drill 4 through holes of 6.5 mm diameter, each centre 10 mm from the two nearest edges. Make it parametric: put the sizes in parameters, with the thickness parameter named t.
turns: Make the holes 8 mm in diameter with their centres still 10 mm from the edges, and chamfer the four outer top edges 1 mm.
